title: What Is Copper Wiring in Semiconductors? Why the Damascene Process "Digs Trenches and Fills Them"
excerpt: What is copper wiring in semiconductors? This beginner-friendly guide, based on primary sources, explains why copper cannot be etched, the damascene process that digs trenches and fills them with copper, the CMP polishing step, dual damascene, and copper's strengths and its weaknesses as lines get thinner.
